concerns.text: T001 writes the quickstart to `specs/015-improving-accessibility-usability/quickstart.md` while the header and T002 reference `specs/001-improving-accessibility-and-usability-of/`; the two directory prefixes disagree within the same document, so one of the paths is wrong and the quickstart or validator will point at a nonexistent location.

FR-005's single-missing-SUS-item imputation is covered by T004's `impute_sus`, but T002 validates every raw record against `session.schema.yaml`, which requires exactly 10 `sus_responses` ('All 10 must be present'). A session with one missing item fails T002 validation before T004's imputation can run, so the FR-005 imputation path has no reachable task coverage as specified; the tasks need to reconcile validation vs imputation ordering (e.g., allow nullable SUS items at the raw-validation stage).

The constitution mandates 'External HCI benchmark datasets from OpenML MUST be versioned and stored locally under data/' — no task in T001–T012 fetches, versions, or explicitly marks inapplicable any OpenML dataset. Either add a task or record a documented inapplicability decision; as written the requirement has zero task coverage.

Constitution Principle VII mandates ANOVA 'via scipy.stats', but T006 implements it with `statsmodels.stats.anova.AnovaRM`. The deviation may be sound, but no task or note records the justification, leaving a constitution-mandated tooling requirement without covered or explicitly-waived implementation.
